name: computer-use-windows
description: Guarded Windows desktop observation and input automation using short-lived, one-action window state.

shortDescription.en-US: Observe and control approved Windows app windows from fresh state.
shortDescription.zh-CN: 基于最新状态观察并控制经过批准的 Windows 应用窗口。

longDescription.en-US: A high-risk local Windows automation plugin with window-scoped screenshots, bounded accessibility state, one-action stale-state guards, and approval-gated input.
longDescription.zh-CN: 高风险本地 Windows 自动化插件，提供窗口级截图、有界可访问性状态、一次性过期状态保护和需要审批的输入。

permissions: Loads this plugin's Computer Use client inside Anybox's persistent, general-purpose Node REPL.
Uses a short-lived host capability that is bound to the current JavaScript tool call.
mcpRequirements.reason: Provides the Codex-style model surface: persistent JavaScript state with the plugin-owned sky API.

permissions: Lists visible Windows applications and windows.
Captures screenshots and bounded accessibility content from approved applications.
Sends mouse and keyboard input through the Anybox host-owned helper.
Requires per-application approval and a globally exclusive turn lease.
mcpRequirements.reason: Provides a hidden, guarded host capability used by the plugin's sky client; its low-level tools are not exposed to the model.

skillPreviews.name: Computer Use Windows
skillPreviews.description: Operate one approved Windows application at a time through fresh, one-action window state.
